reviews.title: Doesn’t work properly
reviews.text: I revised for 30 minutes and it says I revised for 12, do not reccomend😎

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: This has been a great app and I have loved it, but having worked my way through all the plants I bought the Amazon rainforest form£1.99 but it is glitched and I can’t access it- has ruined the experience and no reply from support. A real shame as it’s been a great app to use until now.

reviews.title: Why am I being asked for my government id for a revision app?
reviews.text: I spent real life money on this app, put in hours of actual revision time to them be forced to give up my government id to use a revision app that’s 13+?! So I won’t be using the app anymore and I’m actually going to find a way to get my money back because I’m not using an app where they’re restricting me to put captions on my studying.

reviews.title: Complicated w no tutorial
reviews.text: There’s no tutorial or anything that shows you the basic procedures of how to use the app, leaving you to feel overwhelmed searching thru it yourself. It felt complicated and too much to bother spending my time trying to figure out.

reviews.title: Glitching
reviews.text: I normally love this app so much but it has been glitching, it won’t let me set a time less than 43 minutes??

reviews.title: New update changed it
reviews.text: I LOVED this app! I got a boost of dopamine every time I finished my studying and grew a tree, and I loved the little anticipation I got when wondering what kind of tree I was growing. It helped me SO so much with executive dysfunction and eliminating distractions. I was recommending it to everyone I knew and it was awesome. However, the new update has completely changed it for me, and now i pretty much stopped using it entirely. I don’t like the new layout and style and I don’t like the monetary system to ‘purchase’ the trees. The interphase when navigating the different journeys/tours is super confusing and unintuitive. I usually don’t mind change, but this seems like a different app and there isn’t any motivation for me anymore to use it. I’m sure someone who didn’t know the app before the update would love it, but for right now, it just makes me sad
